Definition_comparison.formal_excerpt: DefinitionComplete(d) iff StableId(d) and ExactScope(d) and FormalVoice(d) and NonNormativePlainVoice(d) and NonNormativeDomainVoice(d) and Boundaries(d) and AdmittedSources(d) and RegistryPostimage(d) and GeneratedIndex(d) and CurrentDriftRoute(d). DefinitionComplete(d) does not imply Admitted(d).
Definition_comparison.normative_excerpt: A Definition is a versioned, owner-scoped semantic artifact that assigns a term one normative meaning within an exact authority scope. It is structurally complete only when stable identity, applicability, exclusions, a scientific/formal normative voice, explicitly non-normative plain-language and domain-context voices, boundaries, admitted source posture, primary consumers, a synchronized registry postimage, generated index, and a current drift route are declared. Only an exact owner promotion decision can make one exact Definition version canonical authority.

claim_ceiling: Exact read-only provenance facts and a source-bound review question. Existing Definition admission, cited-source admission, model-instance admission and new interpretation fidelity are distinct. No source repair, new promotion, universal source-posture rule or logical contradiction is claimed.

excluded_effects: No Artifact Type or artifact instance is admitted.
No Relation Kind, endpoint pair, qualifier schema, Typed Relation, or ontology-local edge is admitted.
No Policy instance, Decision beyond this admission, runtime, adapter, consumer, migration, publication, release, or deployment is activated.
No later step in the integrated-model admission sequence is pre-approved.
